moveHint: Order and bill move together. Shares already paid stay with the bill.
tableEmpty: This table has not ordered anything yet.
pickCourseHint: Tap to pick the course, drag to move the whole course
recallCourse: Recall it: the course goes back to the queue and off the kitchen screens
fireRemaining: Fire the lines still queued on this course
fireNow: Fire this course to the kitchen now
cancelProposal: Cancel the proposal: the course goes back to draft, the kitchen does not see it
discountOnRecord: It stays on record with your name: it explains the difference at the end of service.
searchDishAll: Search a dish across the whole menu…
clearUnsent: Clear the lines not sent yet
closeAndBill: Close the order and open the bill
